title: Release train: milestones, scope lock & cut criteria for API/Console/Runtime Q2
creator: Tara Nguyen
description: Define and coordinate the release train for the next API/Console/Runtime coordinated launch. Deliver a locked scope, clear cut criteria, milestone dates, and an owner-driven runbook for release notes and GTM tasks. Goal: predictable rollout with measurable acceptance and rollback criteria.
milestones: 2026-03-15 - Milestone 1: Feature freeze request to engineering (all new features must have signoff)
2026-03-22 - Milestone 2: Code freeze for API surface changes; bugfixes only for non-blocking issues
2026-03-29 - Milestone 3: Release candidate build available for QA and performance validation
2026-04-05 - Milestone 4: Final signoff window (security, infra, docs, support, sales)
2026-04-12 - Milestone 5: Production cutover window; feature flags staged rollout
2026-04-15 - Milestone 6: Public launch & release notes published
scope_lock_criteria: All planned API/Console/Runtime features must have an owner and PR linked to release-train board
New feature PRs merged after 2026-03-15 require explicit PM + ENG lead approval and documented mitigation plan
Any change that increases 99th percentile latency by >5% on benchmark suite is deferred unless mitigations are included
Security or compliance findings must be triaged and classified; anything blocker or high must be resolved before lock
Changes requiring schema migrations that affect customer contracts require a migration runbook and customer communication plan
cut_criteria: Feature lacks end-to-end tests covering core regressions
Performance regressions: >5% RPS loss at p95 latency vs baseline
Unresolved cross-team dependency with >72h blocker impact
Docs, release notes, or post-install guidance are incomplete
No assigned owner for post-launch support for the feature
release_acceptance_criteria: Automated test pass rate >= 97% on release candidate across API/Console/Runtime suites
SLO targets met in internal perf runs: p50/p95 latencies within 3% of baseline for 95% of traces
Canary rollout successful for 72h with no P0/P1 incidents
Security scan results: zero critical issues; high issues reviewed with mitigation backlog
Release notes drafted and reviewed by PM + TechWriter; changelog items mapped to KBs
release_notes_plan: Template: TL;DR, user impact, migration steps, API diffs, config knobs, troubleshooting links
Timeline: First draft by 2026-03-29, engineering review 2026-04-01, final signoff 2026-04-05
Distribution: Console banner, docs site post, customer newsletter, partner channel brief
go_to_market_tasks: Marketing: product blog draft + assets (owner: Priya Reddy) - asset deadline 2026-04-05
Sales enablement: one-pager, demo script, FAQ (owner: SalesOps) - deliver by 2026-04-07
Support & Success: playbook for common regressions and rollback steps (owner: CS Ops) - draft 2026-03-31
Marketplace/partners: coordinated release notes + region availability table (owner: Partnerships) - finalize 2026-04-06
Developer relations: sample repo updates + migration examples (owner: DevRel) - PRs merged by 2026-04-08
cross_team_risks: Runtime perf regression discovered late in QA leading to scope rollback and GTM delay
Incomplete release notes causing elevated support volume post-launch
Region capacity mismatch for Dedicated customers during rollout window
Third-party dependency (auth provider) upgrade introduces API incompatibility
